== Set 1 edition names ==
Bill approved consistent Luke/Vader Set 1 names: Original (unnumbered), Numbered (black-on-white) / Numbered (white-on-black) for the distinct Dark Side options, one Numbered entry for Luke’s identical Light Side panels, Premium, and Remastered (2006). Article moves retain redirects; the shared navigators and direct links use the descriptive edition names. Publication history replaces the generic Errata heading on these Set 1 articles; historical catalog codes are retained in source. Card identities, printed text, statistics, images and source attribution are unchanged. Legacy Block classifications are outside this batch. == Date-source audit (18 November 2026) ==
The former Released and Remastered values, 4 December 2006, cited only the remaster sheet’s “Official text as of December 4, 2006” label. That is a text cutoff. Both cells now use the source-qualified bound “by 18 December 2007”: the complete historical Luke image matches the digest indexed for that date in the [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/billbisco/swccg-holotable/4c96e17e10ccdee9201e9b437b17355398f68b8a/historical-recovery/419/metadata/archive-original-virtual-cdx.json retained archive index]. The complete image and the publisher’s two-page remaster sheet were checked against the intended card’s title, lore, game text, statistics and icons. The bound does not assert first publication on the capture day or claim that the replay was newly opened. The article title and edition label are preserved; the text cutoff and PDF metadata are not used as publication dates.

== Printed wording comparison ==
The original Virtual Set #1a sheet and this later complete face use different printed wording. Beyond the expanded standard icons, the Attack Run and control-phase sentences have different printed wording and order.<ref>Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf Virtual Set #1a], complete original sheet; [[:File:Holotable-OVS1-Luke-Skywalker-v17.gif|later complete card face]].</ref> The comparison establishes different printed wording; it does not establish a same-word predecessor for the Remastered date field. The existing edition name and the Released bound for this later carrier are retained.
